title: Public Integrity Forensics: An Auditable Multi-Source Agent for Corruption-Risk Screening from Open Data
domain: anti-corruption / public procurement / beneficial ownership / entity resolution / graph analytics / public integrity / computational social science
summary: An auditable public-data agent that routes procurement, corporate, beneficial-ownership, public-office, sanctions, offshore and disclosure records to applicability-aware forensic checks, then fuses reproducible findings in an evidence graph for human review without equating anomalies with corruption.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C guided design; inherits the evidence semantics and detector-contract principles of ARIS4C011; live public-data source audit on 2026-09-18
